scope.summary: Lock the ScmFactsSource seam inside the git-facts emitter so the productized cloud-ci pipeline can swap Git CLI for a future bespoke SCM facts source without changing emitted face shape or gate consumers.
explicit_non_claims: No emitted git-facts schema, CLI flag, default path, or committed-face format changes.
No additional in-graph git call, shell boundary, workflow, or required status context is introduced.
No source Markdown files are added or modified.
No production deployment, bespoke SCM runtime, or non-Git SCM implementation is shipped in this slice.

hyperscaler_lens.north_star: A public, hermetic, Rust cloud-ci product where SCM facts are a versioned interface rather than an ambient Git side effect.
hyperscaler_lens.scale_property: The seam keeps the producer and gates as pure consumers of committed facts, enabling future content-addressed work-area hashes, RBE cacheability, and a bespoke SCM source without multiplying CI authorities.

facets.F1_correctness: The current Git CLI implementation remains implementation #1 behind ScmFactsSource and the emitted v1 facts shape is unchanged.
facets.F2_tests: Unit tests cover the seam and generated-class filtering; byte-parity smoke and registry-drift prove committed faces are regenerated rather than hand-merged.
facets.F3_maintainability: SCM fact acquisition is isolated behind three primitives: tracked_paths, last_touch, and revision_author_timestamps.
facets.F4_compatibility: Existing oya-ci producer and gate consumers continue reading the same committed git-facts.generated.json face.
facets.F5_security: The single out-of-graph Git boundary remains explicit; no credential, permission, or workflow expansion occurs.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant or personal data processing changes.
facets.F7_operability: CI operators keep one canonical oya-ci-required fan-in while the implementation seam reduces future migration blast radius.
facets.F8_performance: No CI fanout or runtime path is added; future SCM source replacement can preserve cacheable gate consumers.
facets.F9_compliance: Audit-chain and multispectrum evidence record the interface-lock decision without adding Markdown.
facets.F10_reversibility: The seam can be reverted as a code-only refactor while preserving generated-face regeneration discipline.
facets.F11_observability: Evidence captures the non-claim boundary and verification plan for future governance review.
facets.F13_migration: Supports ADR-0526/ADR-0525 migration from Git CLI facts to an owned SCM substrate behind a stable interface.

verification_plan: python3 -c 'import json; [json.loads(line) for line in open("evidence/audit-chain.jsonl") if line.strip()]'
emitter byte-parity smoke against committed git-facts.generated.json
